changes: Slice 2: getIdentifierValue walks the scope chain once; a declarative hit is one map lookup that returns the value or throws the TDZ ReferenceError, with no BindingReference or {error,value} record. AOT entries use it for plain identifier reads (runtime-compiled entries already did).

Slice 3: the binder reports containsWith; outside direct-eval code in units without any with statement, identifier callees use the fused read with an undefined receiver (declarative/module/global records have no base object). The callee is still read before arguments.

Slice 4: global identifier reads walk an all-ordinary prototype chain once (isOrdinaryPrototypeChain + findOrdinaryProperty); an exotic object anywhere on the chain keeps the specified HasProperty, HasProperty, Get sequence.
